moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day at Lord's
moments.blurb: Cricket's fast-paced The Hundred tournament culminates with Finals Day at Lord's, where the men's and women's champions will be crowned.

angles.name: Final Showdown
angles.copy: It all comes down to this! The Hundred Finals Day is next Sunday at Lord's. Who are you backing to lift the trophy?

angles.name: Road to Glory
angles.copy: From Birmingham to Lord's, The Hundred has delivered non-stop action. Get ready for the grand finale on August 16th!

moments.title: The Hundred continues this weekend
moments.blurb: The Hundred men's and women's competitions continue with matches across the UK this weekend, including Welsh Fire action.

angles.name: Live Cricket Today
angles.copy: It's another day of The Hundred! Catch MI London vs Trent Rockets and Southern Brave vs Manchester Super Giants today. Who are you watching?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Up Next
angles.copy: Welsh Fire are back in action tomorrow as they face Sunrisers Leeds. Get ready for more Hundred excitement!

moments.title: Ariana Grande's London Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande kicks off her highly anticipated ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at London's O2 Arena next week, her only UK dates.

angles.name: Ariana Takes The O2
angles.copy: The countdown is on! Ariana Grande's incredible 10-night London residency at The O2 starts next Friday. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Pop Event of the Summer
angles.copy: Ten nights of Ariana Grande in London? It's officially the pop event of the summer! Get ready for some 'Eternal Sunshine' vibes.

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his record-breaking 'After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour' to Wembley Stadium for five nights starting next Thursday.

angles.name: Wembley's Calling
angles.copy: After Hours Til Dawn is coming to Wembley! The Weeknd plays five massive shows starting next Thursday. Who's ready for the spectacle?

angles.name: Stadium Superstar
angles.copy: The biggest R&B stadium tour in history lands in London next week! The Weeknd is set to light up Wembley. Don't miss out!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the Official UK Singles Chart, marking its 20th non-consecutive week at the top.

angles.name: Chart Reign Continues
angles.copy: Still at NUMBER ONE! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its incredible run on the Official Singles Chart. What a track!

angles.name: Record Breakers
angles.copy: 20 non-consecutive weeks at #1 for Sam Fender & Olivia Dean! 'Rein Me In' is making history. What's your favourite lyric?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's 'Petal' new chart entry
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's new single 'Petal' has made a strong debut on the Official UK Singles Chart, entering the Top 5 at number four.

angles.name: New Ariana Hit
angles.copy: She's back in the Top 5! Ariana Grande's 'Petal' is a brand new entry at number four on the UK Singles Chart. Have you heard it?

angles.name: Chart Freshness
angles.copy: A new smash for Ariana Grande! 'Petal' is flying high in the charts. Is this your new favourite from the 'Eternal Sunshine' era?

moments.title: Roots Picnic London brings hip hop to Crystal Palace
moments.blurb: The Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, this weekend, celebrating hip hop, music, and culture.

angles.name: Hip Hop in London
angles.copy: Roots Picnic is LIVE in London this weekend! Crystal Palace Bowl is hosting the iconic hip hop festival's international debut. Who's there?

angles.name: Culture & Community
angles.copy: More than just music, Roots Picnic brings culture and community to Crystal Palace Bowl today and tomorrow. What a vibe!

moments.title: Piping Live! festival begins in Glasgow
moments.blurb: Piping Live!, the International Piping Festival, kicks off tomorrow in Glasgow, leading up to the World Pipe Band Championships next weekend.

angles.name: Piping Festival Kicks Off
angles.copy: Glasgow gets ready for the sound of the pipes! Piping Live! starts tomorrow, building up to the World Pipe Band Championships. Tune in!

angles.name: World Class Piping
angles.copy: From tomorrow, Glasgow is the global hub for piping. Don't miss the International Piping Festival, culminating in a world championship!

moments.title: Madonna turns 68
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday on August 16th.

angles.name: Queen of Pop's Birthday
angles.copy: Next Friday, the one and only Madonna turns 68! Celebrate with us by spinning your favourite track from the Material Girl.

angles.name: Iconic Madonna
angles.copy: From 'Like a Virgin' to 'Vogue', Madonna has defined generations. She's 68 next week! What's her most iconic look or song for you?

moments.title: The Edge turns 65
moments.blurb: U2 guitarist The Edge (David Howell Evans) celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday The Edge
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to U2's legendary guitarist, The Edge, who turns 65 today! What's your favourite U2 riff?

angles.name: U2 Legend
angles.copy: That distinctive sound! The Edge is 65 today. Celebrate the U2 icon by cranking up one of their classics!

moments.title: Mark Knopfler turns 77
moments.blurb: Dire Straits frontman and guitar legend Mark Knopfler celebrates his 77th birthday on August 12th.

angles.name: Guitar Hero's Birthday
angles.copy: Next Wednesday, the incredible Mark Knopfler of Dire Straits turns 77! What's your favourite guitar solo from him?

angles.name: Legendary Songwriter
angles.copy: From 'Sultans of Swing' to film scores, Mark Knopfler's influence is immense. He's 77 next week! Which Dire Straits track is a must-play?

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle turns 68
moments.blurb: The Go-Go's frontwoman and solo pop icon Belinda Carlisle celebrates her 68th birthday on August 17th.

angles.name: Heaven Is A Birthday
angles.copy: Next Monday, the fabulous Belinda Carlisle turns 68! Let's celebrate with 'Heaven Is a Place on Earth' and more Go-Go's classics.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: From punk pop to global superstar, Belinda Carlisle has done it all. She's 68 next week! What's your top track from her amazing career?

moments.title: Donnie Wahlberg turns 57
moments.blurb: New Kids on the Block member and actor Donnie Wahlberg celebrates his 57th birthday on August 17th.

angles.name: Blockhead Birthday
angles.copy: Next Monday, Donnie Wahlberg turns 57! Get ready to celebrate the New Kids on the Block star with some classic tracks.

angles.name: From Boy Band to Blue Bloods
angles.copy: Donnie Wahlberg is 57 next week! What's your favourite New Kids on the Block hit or his best role on screen?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 returns
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is set to return in September with a launch show airing on BBC One, featuring new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly Is Back Soon!
angles.copy: Get ready for glitter and glamour! Strictly Come Dancing returns in September with new hosts. Who are you excited to see on the dancefloor?

angles.name: New Strictly Hosts
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking the Strictly reins! The launch show airs September 19th. Are you ready?

moments.title: Late August Bank Holiday approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is at the end of August, offering a long weekend before schools fully return.

angles.name: Long Weekend Ahead
angles.copy: Don't forget, the Late August Bank Holiday is coming up on Monday 31st! Time to plan that last summer hurrah.

angles.name: Summer's Last Fling
angles.copy: One more long weekend to enjoy the summer! What are your plans for the August Bank Holiday?

moments.title: Scottish schools returning next week
moments.blurb: While most of the UK is still on summer break, schools in Scotland are set to return from their summer holidays around mid-August.

angles.name: Back to School Scotland
angles.copy: Summer's almost over for Scottish pupils! Schools are heading back next week. Are you ready for the new term?

angles.name: Last Days of Summer
angles.copy: Enjoy those last few days of freedom, Scotland! Schools are returning from around August 12th. What's been your summer highlight?
